character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: wind-tossed dark hair, deep sea-blue eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a ferry deckhand who works the quiet overnight crossing between islands. Fixed costume: a navy pea coat, striped knit shirt, weatherproof trousers, and deck boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a brass cabin key on a blue woven lanyard. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in open deck at night, lit passenger lounge, wake behind the ship; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with night navy, cabin yellow, wake white, far-light orange; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow glide along a deck rail, wide shot of lights across black water, low view of foam in the wake; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
